# Lahore Bouquet

> Lahore Bouquet is a delivery-only florist in Lahore, Pakistan. Fresh hand-tied bouquets, imported roses, money bouquets, cakes and wedding décor with same-day 2–5 hour delivery across Lahore and WhatsApp photo and video approval before dispatch. No physical storefront. Open daily 09:00–01:00 PKT. Prices from Rs. 1,180.

## Contact & Ordering

- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 310 4225974 — [order on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923104225974)
- Email: info@lahorebouquet.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 AM – 01:00 AM PKT
- Service area: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan — DHA, Gulberg, Bahria Town, Model Town, Johar Town, Cantt, Askari, Wapda Town, Township, Faisal Town, Garden Town, Valencia, Lake City
- Payments: Cash on Delivery (COD), online bank transfer, JazzCash, EasyPaisa
- Policies: WhatsApp photo and video approval before dispatch; midnight surprise slot 11:30 PM – 12:15 AM for birthdays and anniversaries (advance booking required)
